My daughter and her husband left me alone at an expensive restaurant with one last instruction: finish the cocktail they had ordered for me. Seconds after the doors closed behind them, our server leaned across the table and whispered, "Ma’am, whatever you do, don’t touch that glass."
His name was Owen, and he looked terrified.
The drink beside my plate was pale gold, with a thin curl of lemon peel floating near the rim. I had never ordered it.
